title: Estrogenic Activity of Structurally Distinct PFASs Through Estrogen Receptor Pathway.
authors: Hu, Fanglin; Lu, Tingyu; Li, Minjie; Wu, Weichao; Li, Fangfang; Chen, Yafang; Xie, Kun; Zhou, Xinyi; Guo, Liang-Hong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PFASs通过雌激素受体通路的雌激素活性，虽含分子对接模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA), perfluorooctane sulfonate (PFOS), and perfluorohexane sulfonic acid (PFHxS) have been listed under the Stockholm Convention and are being progressively phased out worldwide; environmental prevalence and human exposure to other poly- and perfluoroalkyl substances (PFASs) with different structures are on the rise. However, the toxic effects and mechanisms of other PFASs remain unclear. This study explored and compared the estrogenic effects and underlying mechanisms of eight typical PFASs. PFOA, PFOS, PFHxS, and perfluorooctane sulfonamide (PFOSA) promoted the proliferation of MCF-7 cells, with PFOSA exhibiting the strongest estrogenic effect among the eight targeted PFASs. Specifically, for the PFASs with the same number of carbons and different functional groups, the estrogenic effect is in the decreasing order of PFOSA (sulfonamide group) > PFOS (sulfonic acid group) > PFOA (carboxylic acid group). The observed enhancement was likely caused by estrogen receptor (ER) activation, as an ER antagonist significantly inhibited the pro-proliferation effect. Luciferase reporter gene assays, fluorescence competitive binding assays, and molecular docking simulation were used to furnish supplementary evidence for the direct action of PFASs on the ER. PFOA, PFHxS, PFOS, and PFOSA can activate ER transcriptional activity and bind to the ER, demonstrating that ER is a potential target of PFASs. For PFOA, PFOS, and PFOSA, the rank order of binding affinities with ER in fluorescence competitive binding assays and the calculated binding energy in molecular docking simulation were consistent with the results of the cell proliferation experiment and luciferase reporter gene assays, suggesting that receptor binding affinity also plays a critical role in the activation effect of the ER pathway. Overall, our results indicate the estrogenic effects of other PFASs through ER-mediated pathways and elucidate the molecular mechanism for the different activity of eight PFASs, as well as suggest that PFOS precursors require more attention when determining the environmental risk of PFASs.
abstract_zh: 全氟辛酸（PFOA）、全氟辛烷磺酸（PFOS）和全氟己烷磺酸（PFHxS）已被列入《斯德哥尔摩公约》，并在全球范围内逐步淘汰；然而，其他不同结构的聚氟烷基物质和全氟烷基物质（PFASs）在环境中的普遍存在及人类暴露水平正在上升。然而，其他PFASs的毒性效应及其机制仍不清楚。本研究探讨并比较了八种典型PFASs的雌激素效应及其潜在机制。PFOA、PFOS、PFHxS和全氟辛烷磺酰胺（PFOSA）促进了MCF-7细胞的增殖，其中PFOSA在八种目标PFASs中表现出最强的雌激素效应。具体而言，对于具有相同碳数和不同官能团的PFASs，其雌激素效应按以下顺序递减：PFOSA（磺酰胺基团）> PFOS（磺酸基团）> PFOA（羧酸基团）。观察到的增强效应可能由雌激素受体（ER）激活引起，因为ER拮抗剂显著抑制了促增殖效应。荧光素酶报告基因实验、荧光竞争结合实验和分子对接模拟被用于提供PFASs直接作用于ER的补充证据。PFOA、PFHxS、PFOS和PFOSA能够激活ER转录活性并与之结合，表明ER是PFASs的潜在靶点。对于PFOA、PFOS和PFOSA，荧光竞争结合实验中与ER的结合亲和力排序及分子对接模拟中计算的结合能与细胞增殖实验和荧光素酶报告基因实验的结果一致，表明受体结合亲和力在ER通路的激活效应中也起着关键作用。总体而言，我们的结果表明，其他PFASs通过ER介导的途径产生雌激素效应，并阐明了八种PFASs不同活性的分子机制，同时提示在评估PFASs的环境风险时，PFOS前体物质需要更多关注。
